fly.title: FPV. On the go.
fly.subtitle: A lightweight FPV simulator that runs in your browser. Connect a compatible controller and fly on your computer or phone, wherever you go. Low-poly worlds, detailed drones. No installation.
fly.name: Pilot name
fly.prototype: Flight prototype · physics still needs radio testing and tuning.
online.empty: No open rooms yet. Create one and share its code.
online.wait: Waiting for the host to start.
online.disconnected: Connection lost. The drone was disarmed; reconnect from the menu.
settings.title: Your radio. Your rates.
settings.subtitle: Calibrate your sticks, set each axis, and save a profile for each aircraft.
input.noRadio: No radio detected. Keyboard is available.
settings.hardware: USB joystick mode is required. Move a stick after connecting. TX15, Pocket and DJI compatibility still needs hardware testing.
settings.keysHint: Click a binding and press a key. Arrow keys give full stick deflection; Shift gives fine control. H sets hover throttle; it does not hold altitude.
settings.calibrating: Move all sticks to both endpoints for six seconds.
settings.invalidRates: Check the rates: Max Rate must be at least Center Sensitivity; Expo is between 0 and 1.
records.title: Chase your best.
records.subtitle: Separate categories for each map, aircraft and flight mode. Local times and server-verified times are shown separately.
records.empty: No completed laps in this category yet.
records.unavailable: Online records are unavailable. Local time trials still work.
orientation.hint: The flight deck works best with a wide view.
meta.description: Lightweight FPV simulator in your browser. Fly on desktop or phone with a compatible controller. Low-poly worlds, detailed drones. No installation.

hud.start: Cross gate 1 to start the clock.
hud.interrupted: Flight paused and disarmed; this lap is invalid.

simulation.title: Simulation options
simulation.hint: Enable each effect separately. Reset restores the battery and propellers.

simulation.lockedHint: The host’s rules apply to everyone. Simulation options are locked after starting.
simulation.recordsHint: Records are also separated by the selected simulation options and wind.
